newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Jabil Circuit attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Jabil Circuit attractive.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Keith Dunne has started coverage of shares of Jabil Circuit Ltd with a long-term attractive rating and a price target of $45 to $47 a share.
-- In a statment, Dunne said he expects the electronics manufacturing and services company to grow its earnings per share by 30 percent over the next few years.
-- He estimates the company will earn $2.05 a share in 1997 and $2.50 a share in 1998.
